_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil base rate (0 of 47 windows moved ±2+) and the analyst's 0-for-15 move-call record make HOLD the skilled, graded call — a directional bet here requires seeing the breaker (ETF flows >30 sustained or stablecoin growth reversing above 45), and neither has appeared.
next_move.brains_agree: No — the analyst calls HOLD while the narrative implies an upward reversal; the judge sides with the analyst's higher trust weight (7.67 vs 6.00) because the on-chain divergences materially weaken the analog the narrative relies on.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows sustained above 30 with stablecoin growth climbing above 45 and exchange netflow dropping below 70
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX breaks above 80 with BTC 30-day momentum dropping below 35 and funding turning negative, confirming a panic liquidation cascade
